title: Closing down the first base and transfer to the second base

tellings.quote: That base is actually I I close that base down. um the base itself closed, the entire base, not just our aspect of it.

plain: Between 1990 and 1993, the base where a secret programme called PPD was run was shut down and the work moved to a second base. That is the account of Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens, and who tells Michels he took part in it himself: "I close that base down," he says, adding that the whole base closed, "not just our aspect of it." If true, it would mean his alien-contact programme was big enough to move from one site to another.
